## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics
- **2026-04-24 — Claude Projects process-automation pattern**  
  Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-0F1uO5duak  
  Workflow: turn a repeatable business process into a Claude Project by documenting the process, converting it into an interactive prompt sequence, then loading that sequence as project instructions. Example use case: converting webpage copy into a LinkedIn campaign.  
  **Setup:** document the process step by step; ask Claude to convert it into an interactive prompt sequence; paste the resulting sequence into Claude Project instructions; test on a narrow process before expanding.  
  **Available now:** Yes, via Claude Projects.  
  **Why it matters:** Practical operator pattern: constrain the model to a bounded workflow instead of asking for broad, underspecified automation.

- **2026-04-24 — Agentic workflow build pattern with Claude Code**  
  Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tDGiWn0flK8  
  Workflow: use Claude Code to build agentic automations by describing the desired outcome and letting the system plan, implement, test, and repair the workflow.  
  **Setup:** define the business outcome; specify inputs, outputs, and constraints; let Claude Code create the workflow; review errors and iterate; reserve deterministic tools for predictable steps.  
  **Available now:** Yes, via Claude Code.  
  **Why it matters:** Useful tactical distinction: keep deterministic automation for stable steps, use agentic tooling where judgment, research, or variable inputs dominate.
